_note: Map features. Resource nodes are placed in a ring around the hearth (min_distance/max_distance override the ring); dens far out in the wilds. heroes_only nodes are out in hero territory: townsfolk never gather them, heroes pick them up and sell them to the settlement once the buyer building stands, for price shells each, while it holds fewer than buy_until. wild nodes sit by the dens: heroes fetch them the same way, and townsfolk only go when no monster is within wild_safe_radius (so once heroes have cleared the den nearby). tags = descriptive tags (see data/tags.json): buildings that tend nodes ("tends" in buildings.json) key on them. age = the node only counts once the town reaches that age. count 0 = never placed at the start (embers appear where the shifting earth swallows a node, see data/plates.json); regrows false = it never grows back. find = an earth find the shifting earth leaves (data/plates.json finds): greedy and bold heroes dig it out for an item (find_* in balance.json); nobody gathers it. A den's later = from that round on, it spawns something else (by round, never by age). A den with camp = true is never placed at the start: it is the war camp raiders held back by catch-up make (see _camp_note in balance.json).
